model_details.name: BC5CDR Clinical NER — CRF
model_details.task: BC5CDR NER — Chemical and Disease extraction from PubMed abstracts
model_details.benchmark: BC5CDR (BioCreative V CDR) — industry standard biomedical NER

intended_use.primary_use: Extract Chemical and Disease entities from biomedical literature

dataset.source: BC5CDR — BioCreative V CDR Task (tner/bc5cdr on HuggingFace)

business_impact.note: Cost based on pharma clinical NLP workflow estimates

limitations: Trained on PubMed abstracts — may underperform on clinical EHR notes
BC5CDR covers 2 entity types only (Chemical + Disease)
Requires retraining for post-2024 drug approvals
ethical_considerations: Model predictions must not replace physician judgment
All Chemical entities in ADE context flagged for human review
